worldcombat.skill.syrupbomb.summary: Hurl a bomb of thick malt syrup that bursts into a pool of candy; coated foes lose one Speed stage per wave for three waves, and the landing spot leaves a sticky puddle that grabs whoever steps in. The bomb flies on an arc, so it can be dodged.
worldcombat.skill.syrupbomb.use.0: Slow a whole charging group at once
Only the target struck directly by the bomb takes about %1$s special damage; the burst itself deals no damage.
Blast radius %1$s; every enemy inside is coated for %2$s and loses one Speed stage every %3$s.
A coated target loses %1$s Speed stages in total; if the coating is removed, the remaining drops end early.
The landing point leaves a sticky puddle of radius %1$s for %2$s; an enemy that steps in is rooted for %3$s and cannot move.
Throw range %1$s blocks, bomb speed %2$s, hit radius %3$s; the bomb arcs toward the landing point and can be dodged or blocked by terrain in flight.
worldcombat.skill.syrupbomb.preference.t: On: blast x1.4, puddle x1.3 and 10 ticks more cooldown, but a slower and harder-to-land bomb. Off: a light, fast bomb with a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.syrupbomb.preference.a: The companion only considers a bomb while a target is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger starts sooner.
The companion only throws with at least this many enemies inside the blast; 1 means throw on sight.
When on, the companion may leave its post to throw a bomb under a Hold order.
world_combat.move.syrupbomb.text.fizzle: The syrup burst on empty ground
